{{Quote|I served with Korrd on Corellia. If there's one thing I can say about the man, it's 'Do not underestimate him.'|An Imperial commando|<ref name="TOR:Retaliation">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Retaliation|the ''Executioner''}}</ref>}}
'''Seeral Korrd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I do admire how dedicated Colonel Korrd is to his soldiers. Maybe if we all weren't in mortal danger, he'd loosen up a bit.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]]|<ref name="TOR:Fortification">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Fortification|Manaan}}</ref>}}
Seeral Korrd was born shortly before the [[Battle of Korriban]] and the start of the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="Korrd Codex" /> in 3681 BBY.<ref name="Timeline6date" /> Both of Korrd's parents were high-ranking and respected members of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], which guaranteed his admittance into prestigious Imperial military academies.<ref name="Korrd Codex" />

In [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The Battle of Hoth is logged in the ''[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]'' under the date "21378.00.213", while the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], which occurs in [[3653 BBY]], per ''[[Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'', is logged under the date "21390.02.056", which means the event occurred 12 years before the Sacking, in [[3665 BBY]].</ref> Korrd's older brother [[Harkas Korrd]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], an event which devastated Korrd and prompted him to request transfer out of his specialized combat program so that he could study coordinating and transferring supplies. Due to his age and reputation, Korrd was transferred to a quiet outpost on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Korrd Codex" />

During the [[Reconquest of Ord Radama]], Korrd bore witness to the cost of running an extensive campaign with limited provisions and he vowed to keep soldiers from fighting in such conditions.<ref name="Korrd Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Colonel_Korrd_on_Manaan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Colonel Korrd on Manaan]]
Colonel Korrd only appears in the Imperial storyline. He circumvents [[Darth Norok]]'s order for full-scale subjugation of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] in favor of a more covert [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] extraction operation. Korrd does this to preserve the lives of the imperial personnel, who do not have the numbers required for a proper assault. When Darth Norok is briefly captured by the enemy forces, Korrd goes as far as to fabricate the orders in his name. His deception is eventually uncovered by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] after they release Norok from confinement and hear his side of the story. If Darth Norok is kept alive, he will force-choke Korrd until ordered to stop by [[Darth Krovos]], as Korrd is her subordinate, not Norok's. Player can take either Korrd's side or Norok's before Krovos. If Korrd is exposed, players can either let him be taken to Krovos on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] or kill him on the spot. If the player killed Darth Norok previously, they can likewise expose Korrd before Krovos or cover for him completely.<ref name="TOR-LOTS" />
